method: Read-only independently calculated candidate source geometry from frozen original LW07b observed lens n(z) support metadata, plus LW08 numerical-antisymmetry stop. No actual source n(z), DES observed gamma_t, galaxy bias nuisance, bandpower response, full covariance or calibrated eta tangent was loaded. Canonical LW20 source-lock program committed but NOT executed in researcher WSL.

target.probe: GGL galaxy positions x background tangential shear

physics_model.cross_spectrum: P_{delta,W}, original LW06 has signed first-order native cross product response; LW08 differential response unresolved
physics_model.GGL_Limber: C_ell^{gkappa}=s_kappa ell(ell+1) int dchi n_L(chi)b_L(chi)g_s(chi)/chi^3 P_{delta,W}(k=(ell+.5)/chi,z), s_kappa fixed by chosen metric/convergence conventions
physics_model.importance: P_deltaW needed at lens redshifts where n_L is supported, not whole source-range Weyl potential; source n(z) and geometry remain necessary. Full cosmic shear line-of-sight STOP need not transfer to GGL.
physics_model.not_full: Magnification, IA, galaxy bias, scale cuts, exact Hankel/fullsky windows, broad lens tails, covariance and physical eta still open

forecast_formula: t=physical dmu/deta, D=nuisance derivative design, V=observed-vector covariance; F_eta_marg=t^T V^-1 t - (D^T V^-1 t)^T (D^T V^-1 D+P_prior)^-1(D^T V^-1 t)
exact_identifiability_issue: For per-lens-bin amplitude-only t proportional to nuisance derivative dmu/dln(b_l), with flat bias prior, Schur Fisher for eta vanishes even if the un-marginalized signal-to-noise is nonzero. A nonzero native Weyl response is not by itself a detectable distinct memory effect.
stop: No physical sigma_eta, upper limit or significance is authorized. Do not treat lens n(z) fraction as percent of GGL signal. The next science step is an actual physical P_deltaW derivative and source n(z)/angular response/covariance with nuisance closure; if it cannot be constructed, record blocker rather than synthetic detection.
